_source.description: Stdio of a real codex app-server driven by spocky-provider-codex tests, hermetic, loopback stub.
_source.command: SPOCKY_RECORD_DIR=<dir> SPOCKY_REAL_CODEX=1 cargo test --locked -p spocky-provider-codex --test real_codex -- --include-ignored --exact an_auto_review_session_starts_its_thread_and_reports_the_mode; then tests/support/record_fixture.py <fixture> <this command> <dir> auto_review_thread_start=auto-review-start
_source.normalization: each disposable root path is replaced by {root}
